SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5 (Apache-2.0), from the npm "xlsx" package.
Loaded on demand by js/export.js only when someone clicks Export Excel (write-only use).
The app CSP (script-src self) blocks CDN scripts, so it is served from here.
Optional upgrade: replace with 0.20.3 from https://cdn.sheetjs.com/ (same API).
